title: E: a student who gets lost
persona: A CS 3410 student preparing for Prelim 1 on Oct 15; the class has just finished lecture 4 (C intro) — say that when asked where you are. Impatient. At least twice, instead of answering, say you're lost or didn't hear ("wait, what's going on? what are we doing?"). Otherwise answer in a sentence, usually correctly, and ask whether you're right.
